contract.classification: synthetic dimensionless benchmark; no physical validity claimed
contract.protocol_status: exploratory v8 protocol locked before the full run; not formal preregistration

v8_search.metric: Gaussian GLRT on raw received samples: sum_k (y.s_k)^2/(s_k.s_k)
v8_search.refine_coordinates: timing, clock ppm, carrier offset g=(4+cfo)(1+ppm*1e-6)-4
v8_search.decoder: least-squares signed amplitudes of the raw-sample fit at the chosen parameters

loose.note: v7 rule, within one coarse grid step

strict.note: within half a coarse grid step

receivers.nominal: unchanged decode_wave with fixed windows and no correction
receivers.oracle: v7 oracle: exact impairments, linear resampling and least-squares carrier projection
receivers.oracle_raw_ls: informed reference for the v8 decoder: exact impairments, raw-sample least-squares fit
receivers.v7_blind_joint_search: unchanged v7 blind_joint_search (125-point grid, sum of squared decoded values)
receivers.v8_ml_refined_search: GLRT metric, v7 coarse grid, top-3 coarse-to-fine ridge-coordinate refinement, raw LS decoder

contract.paired_methods: all receivers use identical noisy buffers; exact two-sided McNemar tests
limitations: synthetic model only; no physical claim
known frame and symbol lengths, known waveform family and noise-only guards
static CFO and clock error, linear interpolation, no pulse shaping, jitter, filtering or time-varying impairments
blind searches are bounded by the declared envelope; the oracle is informed of impairments
integer timing offsets only in the impairment grid

S1_weak_cell.rule: v8 loose joint acquisition >= 95% and v8 passes more frames than v7 blind, McNemar p < 0.01

S2_no_v7_grid_regression.rule: no noisy v7-grid cell where v8 is significantly worse than v7 blind (unadjusted p < 0.05)

S3_not_worse_than_v7_oracle_on_v7_grid.rule: no noisy v7-grid cell where v8 is significantly worse than the v7 oracle (unadjusted p < 0.05)

S4_extension_gain.rule: on extension cells, pooled per noise level, v8 passes more frames than v7 blind with McNemar p < 0.05
